query: SELECT id, name, category, description FROM recettes WHERE name LIKE '%petrichor%' OR name LIKE '%Pétrichor%' OR name LIKE '%Ancestral%' OR name LIKE '%Forestier%' OR name LIKE '%Minéral%' OR name LIKE '%Tropical%' OR name LIKE '%Nocturne%' OR category = 'resine_cbd' LIMIT 20;
